tests.reason: The reference plugin ships no test suite of its own; its C++ axis is proven by the ABI watchdog, which loads this plugin's standalone-built artifact through PluginLoaderGateTest in the host.

forbidden_symbols.reason: This plugin links nothing but QGCPluginAPI and Qt6::Core, so there is no host-supplied symbol it could start expecting at load time. A plugin that vendors headers-only third-party code (a MAVLink dialect, say) declares that here instead.

missing_dependency_control.reason: The only SDK artifact this plugin consumes is the QGCPluginAPI library itself, and withholding that removes the find_package() the standalone arm is built on — a control that would fail before reaching the axis it claims to test. A plugin that also consumes packaged headers points this at them.
